symbiotes.name: Impermeable Barrier
symbiotes.description: Manual activation: gain 8 armor. Armor can block event damage. If the armor is expended, the symbiote loses 1 of 3 health.
symbiotes.in_encounter_use: Wake it before contact to take a heavy hit, cross a killing lane, or hold a line that would break bare flesh.
symbiotes.out_of_encounter_use: Use the shell to pass crush, heat, pressure, toothfall, or closing-room hazards without stopping.
symbiotes.sapience_hint: It plates over threats before Hymn finishes naming them, but tightens when she wastes it on minor pain.
symbiotes.need: Impact. It stays healthy when used against real force and grows restless when carried idle too long.
symbiotes.relationship_pressure: Repeated activation teaches it that Hymn solves danger by being covered, not by reading the room.
failure_modes: If the armor pool is fully spent, the symbiote loses health.
While on cooldown it cannot answer even if the next room would favor it.
Rooms that read armored bodies may classify Hymn as shield-bearing prey or claimant.

symbiotes.name: Pheromones
symbiotes.description: Manual activation before combat: enemy loses 1 initiative for the next fight.
symbiotes.in_encounter_use: Bleed scent into a fight to make an enemy hesitate, misread opening tempo, or delay the first committed bite.
symbiotes.out_of_encounter_use: Muffle prey-smell, pass nurseries, sour a toll reader, or make weak organisms treat Hymn as belonging nearby.
symbiotes.sapience_hint: It answers social air before spoken choices and lingers around bodies it wants to influence.
symbiotes.need: Audience. It wants living noses, glands, and measuring organs to react.
symbiotes.relationship_pressure: The more Hymn leans on scent, the more the dungeon knows her through scent traces rather than conduct.
failure_modes: It only lasts the current room and then needs quiet.
Predators and social organs can learn the recurring scent.
Some enemies may become curious rather than afraid.

symbiotes.name: Mitosis Unit
symbiotes.description: Passive: saves you from dying one time, then dies.
symbiotes.in_encounter_use: Intercept fatal damage by spending itself as a living spare body process.
symbiotes.out_of_encounter_use: Let Hymn risk a route, bargain, or crossing that would otherwise be unacceptable because one death has a body waiting under it.
symbiotes.sapience_hint: It counts organs and crisis states, not wishes. It is quiet until death gives it jurisdiction.
symbiotes.need: Catastrophe. It exists to divide at the point of loss.
symbiotes.relationship_pressure: Possessing it can make reckless choices feel affordable while making other organisms notice that Hymn carries a spare ending.
failure_modes: It dies when it saves Hymn.
Rooms and witnesses that detect divided survival may mark Hymn as host rather than solitary body.
